# Skyscanner

> > Skyscanner is a global travel search engine that helps travelers compare and book flights, hotels, and car rentals across hundreds of airlines and travel providers.

Skyscanner aggregates flight deals, airline tickets, and travel options from major carriers including Air India, Emirates, Lufthansa, Ethiopian Airlines, and Delta. The platform specializes in flight comparison and booking services for international and domestic routes, with strong coverage of destinations in India, Dubai, Thailand, and worldwide.
